title: Secondary timezone displays off by 1 hour when crossing local DST transition in Clock::jsDateTime()
line: The Digital Clock no longer shows another time zone one hour off when that zone's date is already past a local DST change.
explanation: JS dates have no time zone, so Clock::jsDateTime() faked another zone's time by adding (zone offset - local offset), both taken now, to the current instant. QML then formats that instant with the local offset that applies at the shifted instant. When a local DST change falls between now and the shifted instant (e.g. Los Angeles on the evening before DST ends, Shanghai already on the next day), the two offsets differ and the zone shows one hour off, in the popup list and in the panel when it shows that zone. The fix returns the zone's wall-clock date and time as a local-time QDateTime, so QML shows exactly that wall time; the 'N hours later/earlier' label now compares wall times (subtracting getTimezoneOffset()) so it stays right.

commits.message:
libclock: don't show other time zones an hour off near local DST changes

jsDateTime() added the current offsets to now, but QML formats that
with the local offset of the result, so a DST change in between put it
an hour off. Return the wall time as local time and compare wall times.

BUG: 528109

media.caption: Pure master, local zone PDT with DST ending at 02:00 the next day: at 3:38 PM PDT the popup shows Shanghai (CST) at 5:38 AM, real time was 6:38 AM
With the fix, same setup at 4:20 PM PDT: CST 7:20 AM Saturday, matching real Shanghai time, still '15 hours later'
Pure master, Shanghai switched into the panel: 5:48 AM (CST), real time 6:48 AM
With the fix: 7:20 AM (CST), matching real Shanghai time
